+    (New) ['mod_stock_001']: STOCK
+    (New) ['6a55f339fe4be93a04090acc_Note_Page1_Text1']: TOP SECRET.Priority: RED
+        
+        According to the latest instructions from A.P., all work at the NODE-3 facility
+        is to be suspended. Evacuation of B-190a personnel has been denied. After
+        all personnel not directly involved in ensuring the safe operation of B-190a
+        have been evacuated from the facility, the following is to be carried out:
+        1.  In coordination with security personnel, seal all external blast doors
+        at the NODE-3 facility.
+        2.  Switch the NODE-3 research modules to autonomous operation.
+        3.  Reduce B-190a to the minimum permissible power output.
+        4.  Place the facility under radio silence, transmitting strictly
+        in accordance with emergency protocol em-11.
+        
+        Thereafter, B-190a is to be maintained within a safe operating range,
+        with all necessary maintenance and repairs carried out. Any contact at the facility is to be
+        considered hostile. In the event of an assault, barricade yourselves in the living quarters.
+        New instructions may only be received through the emergency communications channel.
+        
+        To prevent leaks and expansion of the affected area,
+        under no circumstances is operation of B-190a to be stopped!
+        
+        Signed/Stamped  ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲
